avatar.preferences: Isolated browser localStorage and lia_gender cookie; native reduced-motion media preference verified; real rendered character, variant, hybrid renderer and body asset checked before every capture.
avatar.visualQualification: The isolated browser preference and real rendered DOM select BIP male on all nine routes. DOM bounds do not certify a painted body in the PNG. A painted body was not established by every reviewer for Relations, Meetings and Radio; no alternative LIA avatar was identified, and no product/CSS or avatar position was altered to force one.

data: Real frontend routes, handwritten fictional demonstration data. No account, backend, model or external action was exercised. Radio playback used only a local silent WAV; no generated voice was heard.

scenes.name: dossier
exercised: real chat route, rich HTML renderer and active-space indicator
illustrated: cross-source analysis, source contents and suggested next steps; no inference performed

scenes.name: approval
exercised: pending interrupt rehydration and real HITL draft preview, confirm/edit/cancel controls
illustrated: draft contents; no decision submitted, no email sent

scenes.name: knowledge
exercised: real space detail, source lists and indexed-document rows
illustrated: document contents, completed synchronization and embedding costs; no indexing performed

scenes.name: skill
exercised: real SkillAppWidget iframe; existing unit-converter script and its emitted title/HTML/aspect ratio; 2.5m to 250cm conversion; chat scrolled to the request
illustrated: assistant introduction; no skill invocation or provider call

scenes.name: memory
exercised: real memory list, opening its edit dialog and editing the content field
illustrated: existing remembered preferences and metadata; changes not saved

scenes.name: administration
exercised: real administration section, instance ceiling and three users’ quota gauges
illustrated: all usage, account and budget values are fictional; no quota saved

scenes.name: relations
exercised: real Relations overview and person detail; opening commitments and exchanged-email sections; real debrief, scope and contact/peer affordances
illustrated: all identity, relationship context, commitments, messages and debrief are fictional; no connector lookup, inference, call or relay

scenes.name: meetings
exercised: real ready-meeting route, participants, structured decisions/actions, edit/export/reformat affordances
illustrated: report, transcript availability, local engine, indexing and cost metadata are fictional; no audio recording, transcription, synthesis, export or email

scenes.name: radio
exercised: real radio start and pause controls, programme player, transcript, per-line sources, next programme and cited-article list; only a local silent WAV was decoded
illustrated: programme, sources, articles and cost estimates are fictional; no news verification, voice generation, personal-data fetch or provider access
